title: Counit component of the fixed-scalar proper adjunction comparison
statement: The counit component equation in the proper adjunction comparison for the fixed-scalar section-action equivalence.

source.place: Paragraph (3), proper adjunction comparison, respectively the unit/counit mate equation.

proof.text: Localize the underived identity-on-sections comparison and its adjoint mate on the exact section-action equivalence; the derived unit or counit equation follows by the K-injective and K-flat comparison construction described in the parent proof.

from.place: Proper adjunction comparison split into two conjuncts

lean.statement:
theorem proper_adjunction_comparison_counit {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
(∀ K : DerivedCategory (Internal A X),
      (derivedEncoding A X).functor.map
          ((CondensedRing.derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (coefficient A) f).counit.app K) =
        (derivedPullIso A f).hom.app
          ((CondensedRing.lowerStar (coefficient A) f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K) ≫
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.map
          ((derivedPushIso A f).hom.app K) ≫
        (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).counit.app
          ((derivedEncoding A X).functor.obj K))
